Remove/update the misleading line-31 comment that says 'reverted memo'.

Provide working POS credentials for preprod (current owner@kunfamahal.com / Qplazm@10 returns 401) so E2E verification of BUG-249 (Out-of-Stock badge on negative displayQty items) and CR-105 (Show-all toggle + Add Item typeahead) can be completed.

Multiple .bak files present (OrderEntry.jsx.bak.cr008r3, .bak.cr013, .bak.cr013p15-fix2, .bak.d1cap; CartPanel.jsx.bak.cr008r3; CollectPaymentPanel.jsx.bak.* etc.) in the source tree — recommend cleaning them up; they inflate the bundle context and pollute code search.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG-247: VendorSuggestionCell was previously wrapped in React.memo but a code refactor (comment: 'reverted memo — using extracted typeahead component instead') removed the memoization. The extracted typeahead lives elsewhere (AdHocTypeahead inside AutoShoppingList) but the VendorSuggestionCell still renders once per planner row and can re-render unnecessarily on parent state changes. Fix: restore React.memo wrapper on the default export. Since props are shallowly-comparable primitives + ranking object, default shallow-equality is sufficient; no custom equality function needed.
